analysis_role: new chemical alternatives on one source-qualified assay; no independent-family generalization
box_information: known Gal9C binding site from independent 2010 native glycan structure, identical for all alternatives; not blind and not alternative pose truth
clash_note: Distance-only severe-overlap screen, not full chemical validity
confirmatory_status: not frozen; reference quality, family splits, assay labels and precision gates pending
decision: Descriptive; no useful-performance floor or reliability certification
purpose: Prospective fixed-workflow scoring of six size/charge-matched Gal9C epimer pairs against actual measured binding vs operational NB at 2mM; one assay context, no universal nonbinding or calibrated classifier claim
score_aggregation: mean of seed-specific top-ranked Vina energies per compound; lower predicts measured binding; all 3 seeds required
specificity: Not eligible without qualified independent assay labels
